role: Compact AI-authored software implementation advisory, not student final research design, paper or scientific interpretation
live_benchmark_constraint: The frozen360-run benchmark is live. This advisory used only completed published documentation and primary web sources. No source/config writes, tests, project-array reads, partial-outcome analysis, wave solves or CPU-heavy work were performed.
confirmed_problem: The61x61 physical box with40 padding cells has0.249489294 full-record receiver-trace relativeL2 difference from the enlarged321 reference for this homogeneous2km/s,5Hz,10m,1ms,0..1100ms fixture. This is not25% model error, energy reflection, an intrinsic reflection coefficient or a universal solver error.
what_is_already_settled: A separate reference-informed NumPy implementation reproduces the seven faithful traces locally and across Linux/Python versions. That establishes finite-grid implementation agreement, not boundary adequacy. The exact-rational coefficient variant failed its declared1e-9 agreement check and remains retained; replacing generated literals to force a different answer is not a remedy for boundary fidelity.

minimal_additive_software_change.priority: After the live benchmark is terminal, add a NEW explicit boundary/backend configuration; preserve source9f, original seven cases, fourteen replays and all historical receipts. Separate physical extent, absorber extent/profile and boundary type.
minimal_additive_software_change.binding: Hash the actual stencil/coefficients, profile, dt, valid samples, source normalization, receiver map, physical-to-padded mapE and any auxiliary states. Reject nominal/actual operator mismatches; do not patch private fields behind the existing oracle.

measurable_prerequisites_before_any_fide.measurement: Keep old literal-replay regressions immutable. Independently check a new operator before measuring its receiver discrepancy against enlarged references. A changed boundary need not reproduce the old contaminated trace.
Keep damping-versus-undamped comparisons on matching exterior grids and relative nodes, alongside enlarged references. Retain full and declared-window norms with explicit denominators.

Check tangent/adjoint dot products and objective finite differences including physical edges. With extensionE, directions areE*v and gradientsE.T*g. Asymmetric padding/PML auxiliary states need their own adjoint. If boundary coefficients depend on currentm, differentiate them or freeze their design parameters independently.

Preserve a fixed CFL-valid time axis during inversion checks. Changing h/dt requires explicit physical source normalization and common-sample/weighted comparisons; currentdt**2*source/m injection adds no automatic1/h**2 volume scaling. No amplitude fitting or waveform alignment.

Report returned wall, field bytes and saved-history/checkpoint work. A forward-only three-slice check does not establish large-grid gradient feasibility; the current Devito gradient saves its full time history.

boundary_options_for_later_student_owned.implementation: Explicitly extend a guard region while preserving interior parameters, coordinates, waveform and samples. Define model extensionE; do not invent extra geology. Measure cost and reference sensitivity.
boundary_options_for_later_student_owned.limit: Moving returns outside a chosen record is not general boundary validation; the necessary late physical arrivals still have to be retained.

boundary_options_for_later_student_owned.implementation: Use a new explicit smooth profile on a fixed exterior grid, with profile hashes and discrete-adjoint checks. Separate grading from boundary displacement.
boundary_options_for_later_student_owned.limit: A larger coefficient/width is not guaranteed better over a broadband finite record; do not select an unreported passing width after these outcomes.

boundary_options_for_later_student_owned.implementation: Implement auxiliary equations, corners and matching adjoint explicitly. A physical free surface is a separate reflecting boundary choice.
boundary_options_for_later_student_owned.limit: The official Devito tutorial is a simplified first-order acoustic construction and omits overlapping corner subdomains; it is not a validated drop-in replacement.

time_window_and_output_rules: Keep the original1101 stored samples/metrics immutable. Only receiver indices1..1099 were computed; endpoints0/1100 are initialized zeros. A future API should expose valid/computed samples explicitly.

Preserve the old<=250ms split for the old record. New windows must follow needed physical arrivals and be declared before new outcomes; shortening a record to hide visible errors is not a demonstrated remedy.

Mirror-path times are geometric estimates. Noncompact Ricker samples and fourth-order stencil tails prohibit strict clean-window claims. Enlarged-reference agreement is empirical, not continuum truth.
why_larger_damping_alone_is_insufficient: The current coefficient scales with1/(nbl*h); increasing nbl changes grading AND outer return paths. It is not simply a stronger absorption constant.
At5Hz and2km/s the dominant wavelength is400m; lower-frequency components are longer. Layer transition, incidence, corners and the actual one-sided damping derivative can still matter.

The primary boundary-comparison paper reports method/band/domain dependence and effects on both forward and adjoint FWI. PML is also discretization- and incidence-sensitive; this evidence does not choose a remedy for this repository.
A new boundary cannot inherit the native five-point Dirichlet certificate automatically. The actual time-domain fourth-order/PML/free-surface operator and derivative need their own bound analysis.
next_technical_acceptance_evidence: After terminal benchmark state and a separate freeze: explicit operator/profile/source/sample/E identity; independent forward/algebra check; full physical adjoint/FD check; controlled receiver discrepancy over the necessary record; measured cost/memory. Student-owned physical intent and fidelity tolerance remain undecided.

primary_references.supports: Explicit free-surface/PML subdomains, auxiliary boundary construction, simplified corner limitation.
Original study of damping/PML/CPML/HABC effectiveness, frequency/domain extension and forward/adjoint/FWI consequences. The broad comparison is contextual, not a new measurement here.
